preToolUse.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/stackfoundry.sh" ]; then sh "$r/scripts/stackfoundry.sh" guard --client copilot; fi; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: $r = @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($r -and (Test-Path "$r/scripts/stackfoundry.ps1")) { & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$r/scripts/stackfoundry.ps1" guard --client copilot }; exit 0
